content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Classification: deviation (fallback target)**

- **Grant clause identified:** Subparagraph 11.1 Terminal Station Right of Use (p0179) — the licence analogue; it runs "for the duration of this Agreement" (25-year Initial Period under 18.1) and is not revocable at the Terminal Parties' discretion, so it is not walk-away.
- **Fallback element 2 — successor transfer: already met.** Subparagraph 22.3 permits assignment of the whole of a Party's rights and obligations to "a successor of that Party" (p0247–p0248), with written notice under 22.6 (p0254). No edit made.
- **Fallback element 1 — affiliates on written notice: failed.** The 11.1 grant reaches only the Parties (defined as Schedule A signatories); the affiliate mechanics in 12.8 (p0194) and 12.14 (p0199) are not written-notice coverage — they require the Affiliate to be a Carrier plus a cash contribution to the upgrade fund, and they address capacity use/transfer, not the Segment T right of use.
- **Cure:** one surgical insertion into the 11.1 granting words extending the right of use to Affiliates on written notice to the relevant Terminal Party; all untouched words preserved verbatim, minimality gate passed.
- Preferred-only items (contractors acting on our behalf, perpetual/irrevocable paid-up licence) were noted in the rationale rather than drafted, since the fallback is the acceptable position.
